subject: Definition of Done: Playbook + Acceptance Sentinels for Pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Definition of Done: Playbook + Acceptance Sentinels for Pilot

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, I sketched a concise "definition of done" playbook to make the pilot closeable and to reduce ambiguity at cutover. High level notes below and an attached matrix with test owners and pass thresholds.

Goal: agree a minimal set of acceptance sentinels (not an exhaustive QA list) that let both teams sign the pilot as successful and proceed to a committed capacity discussion.

Key acceptance drivers (proposed):
- Functional baseline: 95% intent-recognition accuracy on the 500-sample test set (scored on your annotated set).
- Latency SLO: 95th pctile generation latency <= 220ms for P1 flows under the pilot traffic profile.
- Error resilience: automatic fallback to smaller model variant on model OOMs with <1% degraded-response rate.
- Data treatment: no customer PHI retained beyond session; audit log sample available on demand.

Exit gates (what must be true to mark pilot closed):
1) Acceptance tests green (see attached matrix).
2) Executive sign-off from HealthSync (Sara or designated) + Redwood account owner.
3) Mutual action plan updated with post-pilot SLA / pricing guardrails.

I've attached three artifacts: definition_of_done_matrix.xlsx (owners, pass/fail rules), pilot-acceptance-runbook.pdf (how we'll run the tests), mutual-action-summary.docx (timeline & next steps).

Can you confirm: are the acceptance drivers above aligned with HealthSync's expectations? If yes, we'll schedule a short gate-review session next week and lock owners.

Thanks —
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: definition_of_done_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: pilot-acceptance-runbook.pdf (pdf)]
From: Dr. Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@healthsync.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@healthsync.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Definition of Done: Playbook + Acceptance Sentinels for Pilot

Karthik —

Appreciate the crisp framing. Quick responses inline:

- Functional baseline: 95% on the 500-sample set sounds reasonable; can we add a secondary concordance metric for clinically-sensitive intents (top-1 precision)?
- Latency: 220ms 95p is fine; we need to confirm this under burst load (our traffic spikes in 10–12 minute windows).
- Error resilience: agree — please add an explicit rollback trigger when degraded-response rate hits 3% within a 30-minute window.
- Data treatment: yes, and we need the audit sample to include request/response timestamps and model variant used.

We'll review the matrix with Ben (procurement) to ensure the test owners map to our internal SRE and Clinical Ops teams. Tentatively OK to run a gate-review on Thursday (16th) at 11am PT.

Thanks — Sara
VP Clinical Product, HealthSync
[Attachment: healthsync-testset-v1.csv (csv)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@healthsync.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Definition of Done: Playbook + Acceptance Sentinels for Pilot

Sara / Ben —

Thanks — noted on the secondary concordance metric and the 3% rollback trigger. I'll update the matrix to add:
- Clinically-sensitive concordance: top-1 precision >= 88% on flagged subset.
- Rollback trigger: >=3% degraded-response rate sustained for 30m => automatic rollback and incident flagged.
- Audit sample fields: request_id, timestamp, model_variant, response_hash.

Proposed plan to keep momentum:
1) Karthik/Marissa to incorporate Sara's feedback into definition_of_done_matrix.xlsx by EOD Wed.
2) Run a smoke acceptance run on Thu morning (14:00 PT) — low-traffic dry run.
3) Gate-review Thurs 11:00 PT (Sara suggested) to review smoke results and approve full acceptance run Friday.

Ben / HealthSync procurement: if the acceptance criteria are materially met, can you confirm who will sign the pilot acceptance (title and email)? We need a single named approver to avoid ambiguity.

I'll also attach a short runbook addendum for the burst-load test.

—Karthik
[Attachment: burst-load-runbook-addendum.pdf (pdf)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@healthsync.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Definition of Done: Playbook + Acceptance Sentinels for Pilot

Karthik —

Apologies for the delay — procurement looped in legal and clinical compliance. We can sign acceptance at the VP level. Sara is the named approver from HealthSync (VP Clinical Product). For contractual acceptance, legal needs a short clause that ties pilot acceptance to the acceptance matrix artifact (we can reference the matrix and the gate-review notes).

Two asks from our side:
- Please include a short section in the mutual-action-summary.docx that explains the A/B path forward if acceptance is met (pricing cadence / committed capacity options).
- Can Redwood own the automated evidence collection for the audit sample and provide a zipped export post-run (CSV + run metadata)? This reduces our operational burden.

We'll be at the gate-review at 11am.

—Ben
Procurement, HealthSync
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@healthsync.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@healthsync.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Definition of Done: Playbook + Acceptance Sentinels for Pilot

All —

Solid alignment from HealthSync. Quick operational notes from Redwood side post-gate-review:

- Owners: Grace will run the smoke acceptance and burst-load tests. Vivek will own rollback automation and alerting hooks. Monica will prepare the post-run evidence export.
- Timeline: smoke test Thu 14:00 PT; full acceptance run Fri 09:00 PT; evidence export delivered Fri EOD.
- Decision rubric (final):
  * Green: all core sentinels met (functional baseline, latency, resilience, data treatment) => Sara signs acceptance, proceed to commercial discussions.
  * Amber: minor unmet metric(s) but compensating controls in place; run a targeted remediation sprint (2 weeks) and re-run acceptance tests.
  * Red: critical safety or data-retention failure => pause pilot and invoke incident response.

I'll post the updated matrix and the short A/B commercial path into the Drive folder after this. See you all at 11.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions & Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual-action-summary.docx (docx)]
